🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX falling (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) BELOW TREND and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) plus XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) indicate risk appetite despite only moderate breadth.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX falling (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) BELOW TREND. Credit mixed but modestly supportive: HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) ABOVE TREND while LQD (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +2.21%) CORRECTION.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Yield signals supportive: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) while the yield curve is ↑ rising and Duration Preference is ABOVE TREND. Dollar strength is ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND (system level), constraining cyclical reflation.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Technology leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%). Financials showing strength: Financials (XLF proxy) ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +5.68%). Energy lagging: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%); style: Growth/momentum leadership confirmed by XLK/XLF rising.

5. US vs Global?
US outperformance: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) versus China weakness: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -7.52%). EM strength visible: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) driving broader risk-on flows.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative ETFs active: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.60%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +8.53%) show risk-on positioning. Crypto remains weak: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Copper mixed/correcting: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%). Gold sideways/RECOVERY: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -5.92%) while silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy weak and de-risking: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and broad oil proxies BNO/USO deeply BELOW TREND. Natural gas recovering: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%)) and semis (SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%)) show momentum across timeframes. DIVERGENCE: several industry/retail ETFs are in CORRECTION (XRT CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +9.17%), XAR CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +9.57%))—minor divergences, not regime-breaking.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to growth/momentum ETFs showing confirmed strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%)); reduce exposure to energy-related ETFs showing weakness (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%)) and to weak crypto (IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%)). Bonds neutral to modestly supportive via TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%)), Semiconductors (SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%)). BEARISH: Energy (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%)), Communication (Comm sector -1.69% 1W | -5.77% 1M) showing weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals on continued recovery signals if CPER shifts from CORRECTION to ABOVE TREND (CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%)). BEARISH: Oil/Brent remain stressed—BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency sign) with VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health) with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +2.21%); XLK/XLF gap ~3.57 (Tech vs Financials momentum) with XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Technology and semiconductors (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%)) showing relative strength; key risk is limited breadth and several industry ETFs in short-term CORRECTION (XRT CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +9.17%), XAR CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +9.57%)) to monitor.
